request: Mike, 0916: "generatre new chaingun icons to match our current style of icons. Recolor each text to match what the weapon type is - Bullet weapons - Orange, Lightning - yellow, thermoshock - red/blue shade, laser mist - aqua blue, ice - ice blue, fire - neon red etc."

icons.style: every weapon icon is a framed badge: bevelled ring, dark field, emblem, metal tier tag with a Roman numeral. The chaingun had five loose 64x64 sprites with a small blue number and no frame.
icons.tier_colours: the badges are colour-coded PER TIER (orange, blue, green, silver, red for I..V), which is why every icon in the strip Mike sent is green - they are all tier 3
icons.built_from: micon_icebreath_N for the frame and tag + the existing chaingun_icon_N art as the emblem; the old files are kept as chaingun_icon_N.pre0916.png
interior_cuts_rejected: flood from the centre - the centre IS the emblem, so it flooded nothing
largest enclosed black island - the ring is segmented and its joints are near-black, so field and outer outline are one region; returned 7x3px pockets
bounded by the GREEN ring - only tier 3 is green
per-row layer walk - where the donor crystal touches the ring it runs through, leaving blue streaks in the lower corners
icons.what_holds: the ring is a constant thickness on a hex, so the inset is the median over rows where the walk is unambiguous, applied to every row
other_render_only_faults: the old icon files carry their own tier tag and on three of five tiers it TOUCHES the gun, so 'largest island' brought it inside the badge; it is cut at the gap in the row profile

the first tag guard protected anything bright in the bottom third - which is where the donor emblem is - so the crystal survived below a hard horizontal edge; it is bounded to the tag's measured geometry (rows 99..111, x 19..79)

tints.keyed_by: the icon key family (micon_<family>_<tier>), so a row added later is coloured by existing code
tints.thermoshock: his "red/blue shade" - the weapon is half fire and half ice and one tint can only be one colour, so it takes the violet the two mix to
tints.open_for_mike: MISSILE is grouped with the bullets as kinetic ordnance and LASER keeps the default green; he named neither

probe_result.chaingun_badges: 112px tall on all five tiers, the geometry the other weapon badges use

probe_faults_fixed: asked XART for the reference badge - micon_* icons are rects in BOFX.icons, the third art store iconBlit exists to reach, so it read null against a build where the art is fine
asked for it cold - XART.rdy is false on its first call, which is the call that starts the load
unpacked a colour into a variable named b, shadowing the Playwright browser handle, so teardown called int.close()

barrel.request: Mike, 0916, with a photo of a six-barrel minigun: "chaingun icon should be a chain barrel icon with lvl1-5 upgrade color variants like our current scheme" / "something ike, generate it please."
barrel.generated: SpriteCook gemini-3.1-flash-image, 3 variations, 36 credits (6,324 -> 6,288). The variation chosen has its muzzle face square to the viewer, which is what reads at icon size - the same thing the MG badge emblem does.
barrel.palette_lock: 656 opaque colours -> 161, snapped dither-off to micon_mg_4 (the SILVER tier, the family neutral metal, no hue of its own to inject). pixel:true does not give pixel art.
barrel.tier_colour: a HUE ROTATION measured off each badge own ring, value untouched: tier1 0.060, tier2 0.620, tier3 0.329, tier5 0.008. Tier 4 is silver and reports no hue, so the barrel is left neutral rather than rotated onto noise.
barrel.files: chaingun_barrel_1..5.png beside the badges; the pre-0916 sprites remain as the fallback

superseded: the composite approach in "icons" and "barrel" was rejected by Mike ("you have to generate those chaingun icons by scratch, they look clearly edited") and is kept for its lessons only

generated_whole.request: Mike, 0916: "you have to generate those chaingun icons by scratch, they look clearly edited."
generated_whole.how: one SpriteCook job per tier (gemini-3.1-flash-image, 2 variations each) for the COMPLETE badge - frame, field, barrel and Roman-numeral tag - with three authored badges uploaded as a style reference asset
generated_whole.credits: 120 for the five tiers plus the earlier barrel work; balance 6,324 -> 6,168
generated_whole.numerals: came back correct on every tier and that is NOT guaranteed - each was rendered and read before selection, and one rejected variation had a gold V on a red frame
generated_whole.size: size_behavior is a hint: jobs returned 100, 106 and 200 for a requested 112. Each is scaled to the family height 112 with its aspect kept; tier 4 was re-picked because the first choice came back wider than its siblings
generated_whole.palette: NO lock, measured: the authored family is 2,875-6,329 opaque colours and the generated badges are 4,600-5,600, inside that range. 0905 rule was written against a 61-colour boss plate. Kept behind --snap.
